findings.title: Mobile Phone Number Publicly Visible
findings.description: Your phone number is reported as publicly viewable on your profile or bio.
findings.technical_impact: Direct vector for SIM-swapping, SMS phishing (smishing), unauthorized WhatsApp re-registration, and reverse lookups in leaked breaches.

findings.title: Full Birth Date (Day, Month, Year) Exposed
findings.description: You reported displaying your complete birth date on your profile.
findings.technical_impact: Full birth dates form a cornerstone of identity theft, credit bureau impersonation, and answering security questions for banking or healthcare accounts.

findings.title: Home Address or Exact Residential Neighborhood Disclosed
findings.description: Granular residential location details are visible on your profile.
findings.technical_impact: Destroys physical privacy, exposing the user to physical reconnaissance, harassment, and property record correlation.

findings.title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Disabled
findings.description: Your account relies solely on single-factor password authentication.
findings.technical_impact: Single-factor accounts have zero defense against credential stuffing or data breaches leaking password hashes.

findings.title: Real-Time Location Broadcasts Enabled
findings.description: You broadcast real-time location stamps or live geolocation feeds.
findings.technical_impact: Allows real-world physical tracking, reveals exact coordinates in real-time, and confirms absence from your primary residence.

findings.title: Boarding Passes, Badges, or Work Desks Photographed
findings.description: Photos show corporate badges, flight booking barcodes, or workstation monitors.
findings.technical_impact: Barcodes leak PNRs and passport numbers; visible monitors leak internal company applications or credentials.

findings.title: High Vulnerability to Urgency-Based Phishing DMs
findings.description: Likely to click unexpected links sent via DMs with sensational claims.
findings.technical_impact: Directly vulnerable to credential harvesting phishing kits, session hijacking, or browser malware.

findings.title: Risk of Disclosing MFA Verification Codes Upon Request
findings.description: Willingness to forward temporary verification codes sent to your phone or email.
findings.technical_impact: Guarantees complete account takeover when an attacker initiates an automated password reset.

findings.title: Password Reuse or Predictable Variations Reported
findings.description: The password used for this social account is shared or slightly modified from other websites.
findings.technical_impact: A breach at any unrelated third-party website gives automated bots direct access to hijack this account.

findings.title: Immediate Venue Check-ins Published While Present
findings.description: You publish check-ins at public venues while still physically located at the establishment.
findings.technical_impact: Broadcasts exact physical whereabouts to any observer before you can safely depart.

findings.title: Upcoming Travel Plans and Vacations Announced in Advance
findings.description: Travel dates, airport itineraries, or vacation countdowns are shared publicly prior to trip conclusion.
findings.technical_impact: Signals to threat actors and local burglars exactly when your home will be unoccupied.

findings.title: Predictable Daily Routines and Routes Exposed
findings.description: Daily workout routes, recurring gym schedules, or commute paths are frequently posted.
findings.technical_impact: Enables pattern-of-life analysis and predictable physical interception opportunities.

findings.title: Account Fully Publicly Accessible
findings.description: Your entire profile and timeline are accessible to any anonymous internet user.
findings.technical_impact: Greatly expands passive OSINT reconnaissance surface area and indexing by third-party identity search engines.

findings.title: Friends and Followers List Publicly Exposed
findings.description: Anyone can view and scrape your complete list of personal and professional connections.
findings.technical_impact: Attackers can map your trust network to launch high-fidelity social engineering against your contacts.

findings.title: Tag Review and Approval Disabled
findings.description: Tagged posts, photos, and check-ins appear automatically on your timeline without prior consent.
findings.technical_impact: Third parties can expose your private whereabouts, acquaintances, or sensitive activities without your consent.

findings.title: Connection Requests from Unverified Strangers Accepted
findings.description: You report accepting friend or follow requests from unfamiliar profiles with no known connection.
findings.technical_impact: Allows adversary sockpuppet accounts inside your 'Friends-Only' privacy perimeter.

findings.title: Default Post Audience Set to Public
findings.description: All future posts are broadcast publicly unless manually restricted during authoring.
findings.technical_impact: High rate of accidental personal data exposure due to default open visibility.

findings.title: Participation in Viral Nostalgia / Security-Question Trends
findings.description: Participated in viral questionnaire posts (e.g. first car, childhood street, pet name).
findings.technical_impact: Publicly reveals common password reset security question answers to OSINT investigators.

findings.title: Third-Party App Access Tokens Never Audited
findings.description: No periodic revocation of connected third-party OAuth apps and integrations.
findings.technical_impact: Dormant third-party apps retain API permissions to read profile data, inbox, or contact graphs.

findings.title: Third-Party Apps Granted Broad or Unverified Permissions
findings.description: External apps hold permissions to read private messages, friend lists, or publish posts.
findings.technical_impact: Supply chain compromise of any connected app exposes private social media account assets.

findings.title: Dormant / Abandoned Social Accounts Left Online
findings.description: Old social accounts with forgotten passwords remain active on legacy platforms.
findings.technical_impact: Dormant accounts are easy targets for silent takeover and reputation poisoning.

findings.title: Family Relationships & Dependents Explicitly Mapped
findings.description: Family members and relationship links are publicly tagged.
findings.technical_impact: Provides threat actors with mother's maiden names, siblings' names, and family context exploited in emergency caller/bail scams.

findings.title: Unrecognized Login Alerts Disabled or Unconfirmed
findings.description: Real-time notifications for unrecognized logins from new devices or unknown locations are not verified.
findings.technical_impact: Compromised accounts can be accessed and controlled without immediate defender detection.

findings.title: Active Logged-In Sessions Rarely or Never Audited
findings.description: No routine review of active session tokens across old phones, workstations, or borrowed computers.
findings.technical_impact: Persistent session cookies remain valid for months, allowing physical or token-theft hijacking.

findings.title: Camera GPS Geotagging Enabled on Photos
findings.description: Photos may retain embedded EXIF GPS coordinates when captured or exported.
findings.technical_impact: If uploaded to uncompressed platforms or shared directly, high-resolution EXIF coordinates reveal home and work locations.

findings.title: Profile Indexed by External Search Engines
findings.description: Public search engines (Google, Bing) cache and index your profile link and summary.
findings.technical_impact: Historical records and snippet caches remain searchable even if post privacy is later tightened.

findings.title: Unrestricted Tagging Permissions
findings.description: Anyone on the platform is permitted to tag you in posts or images.
findings.technical_impact: Exposes your account to tag-spam campaigns, crypto scam promotions, and unsolicited association.

findings.title: Years of Historical Public Posts Left Unaudited
findings.description: Past posts from 3+ years ago remain publicly searchable without archiving.
findings.technical_impact: Historical posts provide extensive personal timeline context used in credential recovery and profiling.

findings.title: Identical Handle Reused Across All Platforms
findings.description: The exact same username is used across social, gaming, forums, and professional networks.
findings.technical_impact: Allows rapid cross-platform correlation using automated OSINT recon scripts (e.g. Sherlock).

findings.title: Stale Connections Never Audited
findings.description: No routine review of existing connections or removal of dormant/compromised accounts.
findings.technical_impact: Hacked legacy accounts among friends remain inside your trusted network.

recommendations.finding_title: Mobile Phone Number Publicly Visible
recommendations.action: Remove or strictly hide your mobile phone number from all public profiles.
recommendations.step_by_step: Navigate to Account Settings -> Personal Information -> Contact Info -> Set Phone Visibility to 'Only Me' or remove it from public display.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: High (Protects against SIM swapping, smishing, and identity correlation)

recommendations.finding_title: Full Birth Date (Day, Month, Year) Exposed
recommendations.action: Hide your birth year or privatize your full date of birth completely.
recommendations.step_by_step: Go to Edit Profile -> Basic Info -> Birthday -> Toggle Birth Year to 'Only Me' or hide the entire date.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: High (Eliminates a primary data point used in financial identity theft and account resets)

recommendations.finding_title: Home Address or Exact Residential Neighborhood Disclosed
recommendations.action: Remove residential street address, apartment number, or specific neighborhood from your bio.
recommendations.step_by_step: Edit Profile -> Places Lived -> Remove specific residential entries or set to general region only.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: High (Preserves physical home safety and prevents stalking)

recommendations.finding_title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Disabled
recommendations.action: Enable Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) immediately using a mobile authenticator app.
recommendations.step_by_step: Go to Settings -> Security & Login -> Two-Factor Authentication -> Choose 'Authentication App' (e.g. Google Authenticator, Bitwarden, or 1Password) and save backup codes.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Critical (Blocks over 90% of automated credential stuffing attacks)

recommendations.finding_title: Real-Time Location Broadcasts Enabled
recommendations.action: Disable real-time location sharing and avoid live venue updates.
recommendations.step_by_step: Turn off device-level location access for the social media app in Phone Settings -> Privacy -> Location Services. Stop broadcasting live stories.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: High (Eliminates physical surveillance and home vacancy signaling)

recommendations.finding_title: Boarding Passes, Badges, or Work Desks Photographed
recommendations.action: Review and delete photos showing boarding passes, ID badges, or workplace computer screens.
recommendations.step_by_step: Search your photo timeline for travel and work photos. Delete or archive posts with visible barcodes, badges, or monitors.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Critical (Prevents airline record hijacking and corporate espionage)

recommendations.finding_title: Risk of Disclosing MFA Verification Codes Upon Request
recommendations.action: Never disclose one-time passwords (OTPs) or verification codes to anyone under any condition.
recommendations.step_by_step: Remember: Platform staff, friends, or family will NEVER legitimately ask for your 6-digit MFA code. Any request is a direct takeover attempt.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Critical (Prevents direct session and account takeover)

recommendations.finding_title: Password Reuse or Predictable Variations Reported
recommendations.action: Change your password to a unique 16+ character passphrase managed by a password manager.
recommendations.step_by_step: Use an encrypted password manager to generate a unique random password. Change it immediately under Security Settings.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Critical (Shields account from credential stuffing attacks caused by third-party data breaches)

recommendations.finding_title: High Vulnerability to Urgency-Based Phishing DMs
recommendations.action: Treat unexpected links in direct messages with extreme suspicion.
recommendations.step_by_step: Never click sensationalized DM links. Confirm with the sender through an alternate channel (phone call or text).
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: High (Prevents drive-by credential harvesting and malware infection)

recommendations.finding_title: Immediate Venue Check-ins Published While Present
recommendations.action: Wait until departing a restaurant or venue before checking in.
recommendations.step_by_step: Check-ins posted in real-time pinpoint your exact seat or table. Post retroactively.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Moderate (Enhances physical security)

recommendations.finding_title: Upcoming Travel Plans and Vacations Announced in Advance
recommendations.action: Adopt delayed vacation posting: share trip highlights only after returning home.
recommendations.step_by_step: Store photos locally during travel. Publish albums and stories after you are back in your residence.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Moderate (Eliminates vacant home exploitation)

recommendations.finding_title: Account Fully Publicly Accessible
recommendations.action: Consider restricting default profile visibility or enabling privacy lock.
recommendations.step_by_step: Settings -> Privacy -> Profile Locking -> Enable Private Profile mode.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: High (Restricts overall OSINT exposure)

recommendations.finding_title: Friends and Followers List Publicly Exposed
recommendations.action: Change friend/follower list visibility to 'Only Me'.
recommendations.step_by_step: Privacy Settings -> 'Who can see your friends list?' -> Change from Public to 'Only Me'.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Moderate (Prevents contact scraping and executive impersonation)

recommendations.finding_title: Tag Review and Approval Disabled
recommendations.action: Enable Tag Review and Timeline Approval.
recommendations.step_by_step: Settings -> Profile and Tagging -> Enable 'Review posts that you're tagged in before the post appears on your profile'.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Moderate (Prevents non-consensual location and association exposure)

recommendations.finding_title: Connection Requests from Unverified Strangers Accepted
recommendations.action: Adopt a strict 'Verify Before Accepting' policy for incoming connection requests.
recommendations.step_by_step: Reject requests from empty profiles or strangers. Verify questionable requests out-of-band before accepting.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Moderate (Keeps adversary sockpuppets outside your private network perimeter)

recommendations.finding_title: Third-Party App Access Tokens Never Audited
recommendations.action: Audit connected third-party apps and revoke permissions for unused integrations.
recommendations.step_by_step: Settings -> Apps and Websites -> Review active connections -> Revoke access for any app unused in the past 90 days.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Moderate (Enforces Principle of Least Privilege across OAuth integrations)

recommendations.finding_title: Third-Party Apps Granted Broad or Unverified Permissions
recommendations.action: Revoke excessive OAuth permissions granted to third-party tools.
recommendations.step_by_step: In the connected apps management menu, remove apps requesting inbox or post-publishing permissions.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Moderate (Minimizes third-party data collection reach)

recommendations.finding_title: Unrecognized Login Alerts Disabled or Unconfirmed
recommendations.action: Turn on alerts for unrecognized logins from new devices.
recommendations.step_by_step: Settings -> Security -> Get alerts about unrecognized logins -> Enable Email and Notification alerts.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Moderate (Provides early breach notification)

recommendations.finding_title: Predictable Daily Routines and Routes Exposed
recommendations.action: Vary posting schedules and avoid sharing exact gym or running routes.
recommendations.step_by_step: Crop route maps from fitness tracker posts and blur out identifiable street names.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Moderate (Protects daily physical schedule)

recommendations.finding_title: Default Post Audience Set to Public
recommendations.action: Change default post audience from Public to Friends or Restricted List.
recommendations.step_by_step: Settings -> Privacy -> 'Who can see your future posts?' -> Select 'Friends'.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Moderate (Creates a safe default posture for future activity)

recommendations.finding_title: Participation in Viral Nostalgia / Security-Question Trends
recommendations.action: Avoid participating in viral nostalgia surveys asking for first pets, childhood schools, or mothers' maiden names.
recommendations.step_by_step: Recognize that nostalgic viral challenges are often intelligence-gathering lures. Delete past responses.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Moderate (Protects account recovery questions)

recommendations.finding_title: Dormant / Abandoned Social Accounts Left Online
recommendations.action: Delete or secure dormant accounts on platforms you no longer use.
recommendations.step_by_step: Log in to old accounts, export any photos you wish to keep, and permanently request account deletion.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Moderate (Reduces passive attack surface and credential exposure)

recommendations.finding_title: Family Relationships & Dependents Explicitly Mapped
recommendations.action: Remove explicit family tags and relationship linkages from public bio.
recommendations.step_by_step: Edit Profile -> Relationship and Family -> Set visibility to 'Only Me'.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Low (Protects security question answers)

recommendations.finding_title: Active Logged-In Sessions Rarely or Never Audited
recommendations.action: Inspect active sessions and click 'Log Out of All Other Sessions'.
recommendations.step_by_step: Settings -> Security & Login -> 'Where you're logged in' -> Review and terminate unfamiliar or older sessions.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Moderate (Revokes stale authentication tokens)

recommendations.finding_title: Camera GPS Geotagging Enabled on Photos
recommendations.action: Disable camera location tags on your mobile smartphone.
recommendations.step_by_step: Device Camera Settings -> Save Location / Geotagging -> Toggle Off.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Moderate (Stops GPS coordinate leakage in original image files)

recommendations.finding_title: Profile Indexed by External Search Engines
recommendations.action: Opt out of external search engine indexing.
recommendations.step_by_step: Privacy Settings -> 'Do you want search engines outside of the platform to link to your profile?' -> Toggle to 'No'.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Low to Moderate (Limits search engine crawler caching)

recommendations.finding_title: Unrestricted Tagging Permissions
recommendations.action: Restrict who can tag you to 'Friends Only' or require manual approval.
recommendations.step_by_step: Settings -> Profile and Tagging -> 'Who can tag you?' -> Change to Friends.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Low (Reduces spam notifications and crypto tagging)

recommendations.finding_title: Years of Historical Public Posts Left Unaudited
recommendations.action: Run a historical post audit using the platform's 'Limit Past Posts' tool.
recommendations.step_by_step: Privacy Settings -> 'Limit the audience for old posts' -> Click 'Limit Past Posts' to mass-convert public posts to Friends-Only.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Moderate (Removes years of legacy digital footprint data)

recommendations.finding_title: Identical Handle Reused Across All Platforms
recommendations.action: Decouple usernames between professional, gaming, and personal accounts.
recommendations.step_by_step: Use unique pseudonyms for non-professional accounts to prevent automated OSINT linkage.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Low (Complicates adversary reconnaissance across different platforms)

recommendations.finding_title: Stale Connections Never Audited
recommendations.action: Perform a biannual connections spring-cleaning.
recommendations.step_by_step: Scroll through your friends list and unfriend or unfollow people you do not recognize or interact with.
recommendations.risk_reduction_impact: Low (Maintains a clean and trusted circle)
